outcome: maternal complications (gestational diabetes, splenomegaly, hepatomegaly, thrombocytopenia, osteoporosis, postpartum hemorrhage)
neonatal complications (Gaucher Disease type 1, Gaucher Disease type 3, neonatal death, hospitalization in incubators)
cohort: The study included 15 Caucasian women with Gaucher Disease from a Greek Center of Excellence, reporting on 41 pregnancies.
finding: Most women with Gaucher Disease experience uncomplicated pregnancies and deliver normal, healthy infants, despite a high rate of maternal complications and abortions in this population.
birth_weight: Average female birth weight was 2671.4 ± 851.6 g (range 900-4100 g), male birth weight was 3333 ± 996.4 g (range 1930-4700 g); 37.5% of neonates had low birth weight, averaging 1931.1 ± 420.52 g.
gest_age: Mean gestational age on delivery was 35.9 ± 3.1 weeks (range 26-38 weeks).
